## Overview

Audio-driven lip sync for LTX 2.3 video generation. Two variations:

- **Standard** — lip sync at input resolution. Best for close-ups and medium shots.
- **Inpainting** — auto-crops the face/mouth area for higher effective resolution. Use for wide shots, distant faces, or side views.

Toggle **"USE INPAINTING?"** to switch between them.

> **Disclaimer:** Early proof of concept — will be cleaned up further. Feedback welcome on Discord or in the comments.
